text:
To die a little more each day,

trim one's nails,

one's hair,

one's desires,

learn to think of the small

and the immense,

of the farthest

and motionless stars

in the sky

stained like an animal fleeing,

in the sky

frightened by me.

translation.title: To Die a Little More Each Day
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the daily diminishment and the frightened, animal-like sky.
